chat.title: Chat with Jobhunter
chat.hint: Ask questions ("Which applications are older than 3 weeks?") or request changes ("also look at climate tech in Lisbon"). Changes are shown for confirmation first.

subscription.title: My Claude subscription
subscription.desc: Uses your own Claude Pro/Max plan through the official Claude Code login. Jobhunter never sees your credentials.

api_key.title: Anthropic API key
api_key.desc: Your own key from the Claude Console, stored in your OS keychain. Billed per token to your account.

compatible.title: Anthropic-compatible provider
compatible.desc: Another provider with an Anthropic-compatible API (for example Kimi or GLM): base URL plus your key for that provider.

openai_proxy.title: OpenAI via proxy (LiteLLM etc.)
openai_proxy.desc: An Anthropic-compatible proxy in front of other models. Experimental and unsupported: structured output and tools may not work.

claude.loginHelp: Sign in with Anthropic's official login. Run this command in a terminal, follow the browser login, then click "Check again":
claude.loginNote: The login stays in Claude Code's own credential store. Jobhunter only checks whether a login exists.
claude.baseUrlHint: The provider's Anthropic-compatible endpoint, as given in its documentation.
claude.keyHint: Stored in your OS keychain (or the encrypted secrets file in server mode). Never shown again.
claude.termsNote: Anthropic's terms limit how subscription logins may be used by third-party apps. See docs/CLAUDE_ACCOUNT.md and decide for yourself; you can switch to an API key at any time.

general.title: Language
general.applicationLanguageHint: Language of CVs, cover letters and form answers.

models.title: Models per task
models.hint: Pick a model for each tier, and optionally override single tasks.

budget.title: Budget
budget.hint: When the estimated monthly spend reaches the budget, scans, discovery and auto-drafting pause and you get a notification.
budget.subscriptionNote: With a subscription, costs shown are API-price estimates; your plan's usage limits apply. A budget still pauses non-essential tasks.
